response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(daily) AS overall FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(r.daily - m.overall) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.daily > m.overall
